dct_title_s: Glenwood - Camden Parkway, Humboldt Avenue to Lyndale Avenue, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for a parkway between Humboldt and Lyndale Avenues in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirtieth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 98.
